title: The Economic reason for the change
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：economic　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 economic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the musician wrote of ① an economic reason for the change in the programme, and everybody in the hall said at once that it was ② more economic than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the musician, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the economic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most economic reason for the change anybody in the hall had ever seen, or so the programme for December 1965 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too economic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the economic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an economic report on the town, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as economic as the report on the town they had once had in the old hall. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was economic or not, and he said so.

By 1978 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was ⑦ something economic, and nothing besides. The listener from the next hall called the whole plan ⑧ quite economic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the programme kept the names of the economic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1981, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another economic reason for the change in the same programme, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more economic than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most economic report on the town in the whole hall, she said in 1983, was the one she could never quite name; the economic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 经济（前置定语 an economic reason for the change：1971 年乐师在节目单里记下的那件经济的缘由）
B. adj. 经济／经济上（比较级 more economic than：文中两处，一处比变革的经济缘由，一处比预想）
C. adj. 经济／经济上（最高级 the most economic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 经济（表语 too economic to do：母亲觉得它太经济，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 经济上（前置定语 an economic report on the town：叔叔把整件事称作一桩经济上的经济报告）
F. adj. 经济上（同级比较 as economic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇上的经济报告相比）
G. adj. 经济上（后置定语 something economic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 经济上（受程度副词修饰 quite economic：那位听客的评价）

items.q: an economic reason for the change
the most economic reason for the change anybody
an economic report on the town
The most economic report on the town in

answers.why: economic 意为“经济”，1971 年乐师在节目单里记下的是“一件经济的缘由”，此处作前置定语 an economic reason for the change。
economic 意为“经济”，此处用比较级 more economic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
economic 意为“经济”，节目单上 十二月 那行字说它是音乐厅里最经济的一件，故用最高级 the most economic reason for the change。
economic 意为“经济”，母亲认为这件东西“太经济了，谁也用不上”，too economic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
economic 意为“经济上”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩经济上的经济报告”，此处作前置定语 an economic report on the town。
economic 意为“经济上”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇上的经济报告一样经济上”，同级比较用 as economic as。
economic 意为“经济上”，节目单上那半行字要的是“经济上的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something economic。
economic 意为“经济上”，邻音乐厅来的那位听客认为这套计划“相当经济上”，quite 修饰原级 economic。
economic 意为“经济上”，1981 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要经济上”，故用比较级 more economic than。
economic 意为“经济上”，母亲 1983 年说的是“整个音乐厅里最经济上的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most economic report on the town。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1971 年，乐师在节目单里记下了一件经济的缘由。（an economic reason for the change）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更经济。（more economic than …）
母亲觉得它太经济，谁也用不上。（too economic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩经济上的经济报告。（an economic report on the town）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇上的经济报告一样经济上。（as economic as …）
到了 1978 年，节目单上只剩半行字：要的是一件经济上的东西。（something economic）
answers: In 1971 the musician wrote of an economic reason for the change in the programme.
Everybody said it was more economic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too economic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an economic report on the town.
He said nobody would call it as economic as the report on the town they had once had.
By 1978 the programme asked for nothing but something economic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 economic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1971 the musician wrote of an economic reason for the change in the programme, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most economic reason for the change in the hall, or so the programme says.
My mother thought it too economic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an economic report on the town, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next hall called the plan quite economic, and everybody laughed.
The economic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
